notes.title: Fixed a bug on the level
notes.content:
At level 55, an error was detected in the construction of the level. That is, some places were impossible to get to.
This issue has now been fixed

notes.title: Level 83 was fixed
notes.content: A problem was detected at level 83. It is already fixed.

notes.title: 25 new levels have been added!
notes.content:
25 new levels have been added to the game! Now in the game [b]100[/b] of levels to complete!
Also, the game has been updated to save the results (how many stars collected) from the 50th level to the 100th level.
A full-fledged release will be released very soon!

notes.title: 10 new levels have been added!
notes.content: 10 new levels have been added to the game! Now the game has 75 levels to complete. In the future, I plan to reach 100 levels.

notes.title: 15 new levels have been added!

notes.title: Global change to the interface display. Bug fixes.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37005833/81a81ed4b326c22b3406d1c1d8b9c74ec7b855d6.jpg[/img]

Previously, the user interface might not be displayed correctly on small monitors, or small screen resolutions. But now, in this update, the user interface has been completely reconfigured. Now the game will be displayed correctly on all monitors.
The game has fixed global errors with getting new character skins, as well as errors with getting multiple achievements. However, this issue should have been fixed in this update.

Have a good game!
